The takeaway

Three things to remember

You

One question is tiny.

One ChatGPT question uses about 2% of a phone charge (0.34 Wh, OpenAI’s figure). Billions of them add up: data centres used about 485 TWh in 2025.

Everyone

All of it together is a country.

Data centres used about 1.5% of the world’s electricity in 2024 (IEA). By 2025 that was about as much as France uses in a year, and the IEA expects it to roughly double by 2030.

The claims

Most claims Hum has checked are false or only partly true.

Of 20 checked claims: 5 false, 11 partly true, 3 true, and for 1 nobody knows yet.
